name: Polygon Splitting by Plane Threshold
definition: Splits a 2D polygon (triangle) by a plane threshold in 3D using Sutherland-Hodgman style clipping. Returns two polygons (below and above).
summary: Polygon Splitting by Plane Threshold partitions a polygon into two sub-polygons using a cutting plane, distinguished by operating directly in barycentric coordinates relative to a reference simplex to avoid explicit Cartesian conversion.
